t: The SPEC OMP2001 'runspec' command and its options
s: Long names can also be abbreviated, provided that you still enter enough letters for uniqueness. For example, the following commands all do the same thing: runspec --config=dianne_july25a --debug=99 medium runspec --config dianne_july25a --debug 99 medium runspec --conf dianne_july25a --deb 99 medium runspec -c dianne_july25a -v 99 medium

On most operating systems, the SPEC tools don't mind concurrent jobs. They use your operating system's locking facilities to write the correct outputs to the correct files, even if you fire off many runspec commands at the same time.
New with CPU 2017: The former runspec utility is renamed runcpu in SPEC CPU 2017.
